input.command:
git add src/worker/containers.ts src/worker/env.ts src/worker/api.ts wrangler.toml src/runtime/workflows/heartbeat.ts src/runtime/workflows/plugin-dispatch.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(deploy-cloudflare): implement proper CF Containers DO wrapper pattern

CF Containers run as Durable Objects, not plain Fetcher bindings. Fix the
wrangler.toml format (class_name instead of binding) and implement the full
DO wrapper pattern so containers work in production and fall back to the
external bridge locally (wrangler dev has no Docker).

Changes:
- containers.ts: new SidecarContainer + PluginContainer DurableObject classes
  - Production: start the container, getTcpPort(8080) → proxy request
  - Local dev: this.ctx.container is undefined → proxy via SANDBOX_BRIDGE_URL from KV
- wrangler.toml: fix [[containers]] to use class_name (not binding);
  add [[durable_objects.bindings]] for both containers; add v2 migration
- env.ts: SIDECAR_SERVICE and PLUGIN_CONTAINER typed as DurableObjectNamespace
- heartbeat.ts / plugin-dispatch.ts: idFromName().get().fetch() DO stub pattern
- api.ts: export SidecarContainer and PluginContainer so Wrangler registers them

Local dev now shows the containers as DO bindings in the wrangler binding table.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
input.description: Commit proper CF Containers DO implementation
